messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service `inference-embeddings-eu` — 5xx spike >30% over 2m, auto-escalation window active. PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC-58291

pagerbot: auto-ack attempted but no responder claimed within 120s, escalating to rotation-engineering.

raj: ack @pagerbot @incident-bot — I'm taking this. seeing elevated 5xx on EU embedding workers.

jen: @raj thx — are customers impacted or is this internal retry storm? any specific model?

raj: quick look at logs: many `grpc: upstream connection reset` and `kv cache miss flood` on `embedder-v2`. responses failing at step `kv-fetch`.

sam: @raj can you run the canary failover to us-west? we have spare capacity.

raj: running failover test now. command: ```sh
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/embedder-v2-eu --context=eu-cluster
# then reroute: curl -XPOST https://router.internal/reroute -d '{"service":"inference-embeddings","region":"us-west","weight":30}'
```

lina: pinging infra to increase burst pool for embeddings-us-west by +2 gpus — request sent to autoscale bot. :rocket: 

pagerbot: reroute request accepted. weight adjustments: eu 70% -> us-west 30%. autoscale triggered +2 GPU nodes. estimated warmup 45s.

raj: logs after restart: still seeing `io-timeout` from pod embedder-v2-eu-5, but error rate dropped from 36% -> 18% in last 60s. looks like partial recovery.

jen: customer impact check: Customer metrics show 8% of API keys getting increased latency >3s, errors concentrated on a single model variant `embedder-v2-q4`. No major data loss.

sam: ok. remediation plan: 1) keep routing 30% to us-west until eu error <5% for 5m 2) scale eu embedder pool +1 replica 3) open a followup postmortem if regression persists.

raj: doing step 2 now: ```sh
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/embedder-v2-eu --replicas=6
```

incident-bot: PD update: Incident INC-58291 acknowledged by raj; escalation paused. SLA impact: degraded performance for subset of customers (embedding latency and 5xx).

lina: quick note — thermostat autoscaler had a scaling cooldown of 300s which blocked one of the autoscale attempts; removed cooldown for the embedding pool. keeping eye.

jen: thanks. any signs of cache corruption? can we clear prefix cache safely?

raj: cache looks fine (miss rates aligned with increased traffic). I will clear a small shard to be safe: ```py
# clear shard 7
curl -XPOST https://cache.internal/flush -d '{"shard":7}'
```

raj: shard clear done. monitoring. error rate 9% last 30s. latency trending down.

sam: good progress. can someone confirm PD incident ownership so we can mark routing/mitigation actions?

jen: @raj is the primary until you hand off. I'll take postmortem and customer comms if you want.

raj: agreed. I'll own mitigation and on-call until fully green; @jen you own postmortem and customer impact notes.

incident-bot: Reminder — this page fired inside our configured "silent-window" for scheduled low-noise on-call; auto-escalation behaved as configured (escalated after no claim). Logging incident for review of silent-window ergonomics.

lina: noted — ops runbook suggests reducing silent-window severity for infra-critical services. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

pagerbot: PD: INC-58291 status -> acknowledged, responders: raj (primary), jen (communications).

raj: we're at 3% error rate EU now, latency within SLO for 95th pct. keeping routing 30% to us-west for 3 more minutes then gradually shift back.

sam: when error <2% for 5m, start shifting 10% back every minute. I'll watch the metrics.

raj: confirm: initiating shift +10% -> eu 80% / us-west 20%.

pagerbot: traffic weights updated.

raj: final check: no new 5xx spikes in last 6m, latency normalizing. I'll demote myself from active responder after 10m for handoff.

jen: thanks all. I'll draft a short customer-facing note: "We observed a transient spike in embedding errors in EU that affected a subset of requests. Traffic was routed to alternate region and services scaled. No data loss, issue mitigated."

incident-bot: incident resolved by responders. PD INC-58291 will be closed after 30 minutes of stability or by request. :white_check_mark: 

sam: great work. please file a short postmortem card in the incidents board and include note about silent-window behaviour.

raj: filed: https://boards.internal/incident/IN-58291-postmortem — tagging @oncall-leads. I'm handing off ownership to jen for comms and sam for followups.

jen: taking comms & postmortem lead. I'll follow up with a timeline and action items in the board.

lina: thanks team. closing thread but monitoring for 30m. :eyes:
